examples.scenario: An attacker uses an AI-generated deepfake video and synthetic audio of the CFO to impersonate them in a video call, instructing the finance department to urgently transfer $1.2M USD to a fraudulent offshore account. The attacker initially contacts via email with a short video clip as bait, then follows up via video conferencing platform with the deepfake, exploiting trust and urgency to bypass normal controls.

examples.detection_method: Deploy deepfake detection software integrated with email gateways to scan video attachments for synthetic media artifacts (e.g., eye blink, lip-sync anomalies). Monitor wire transfer requests for large amounts and enforce mandatory out-of-band confirmation (phone call or hardware token confirmation). Correlate newly registered domains mimicking internal executives with email SPF/DKIM anomalies. Train finance staff to recognize deepfake risks and escalate unusual requests.
